🚨 Critical congestion over Mumbai - Pune Expressway | 04/02/2026

URGENT TRAFFIC ADVISORY 
Due to a major gas tanker accident and ongoing leak near Adoshi Tunnel, traffic on both the Expressway & Old Highway is severely disrupted. Authorities have implemented safety halts. Commuters are strongly advised to AVOID the Lonavala-Khandala ghat section entirely.

⚠️ Important Instructions for Citizens
 
Avoid the Ghats: Do not attempt to use the Khandala/Lonavala exits; these are currently bottlenecked with diverted traffic.

Fuel & Supplies: The alternative routes via Tamhini or Malshej add 3–5 hours to your journey. Ensure your vehicle has a full tank of fuel and carry sufficient water and food.
 
Heavy Vehicles: All heavy vehicles are requested to park at the nearest available lay-bys or food malls until the gas leak is neutralized.
 
Use Railways: If your travel is not by a private vehicle, the Intercity Express, Deccan Queen, or Sinhagad Express are the only unaffected modes of transport between the two cities today.

data.text:
‘JUNK SEDITION CASES’: Nagprotesta ang mga progresibong grupo ng kabataan, kabilang ang campus journalists mula sa iba’t ibang probinsya, sa harap ng Department of Justice sa Maynila ngayong Pebrero 4.

Ipinababasura nila ang mga kaso ng sedisyon laban sa ilang campus journalists at student leaders kaugnay ng September 21 anti-corruption protest.

Ilan sa mga kinasuhan ang mga estudyante mula sa Polytechnic University of the Philippines na sila Jacob Baluyot ng The Catalyst, at Tiffany Brillantes ng Youth Rage Against Corruption.

Kinasuhan din sina Joaquin Buenaflor, university student council chairperson ng UP, Aldrin Kitsune, deputy secretary general ng Kalayaan Kontra Korapsyon at estudyante ng De La Salle University - College of Saint Benilde, at Vitrum, rapper at miyembro ng Hiphop United Against Corruption.

“Kung may dapat na sina-subpoena, hindi ang mga kabataan. Kundi, si Marcos Jr, Sara Duterte, at lahat ng mga kasabwat nilang korap sa gobyerno," ayon kay Brillantes.

Bilang simbolikong aksyon, inilabas ng mga estudyante ang laman ng kanilang bag - mga libro, notebook, panulat, at mga gadget sa pag-aaral. Patunay raw ito na walang mali sa pag-aaral ng lipunan at pagtutol laban sa korapsyon sa ilalim ng administrasyon Marcos Jr.

Ulat nila Jhona Reyes Vitor, Renalyn Ramirez, Joseph Gloria, Divine Miranda, at JCM/Altermidya

data.text:
Movement at the Cabinet level is accelerating, and sources say the timeline is far tighter than many expected. Multiple industry insiders now say a leadership change at the Department of Tourism is imminent, with Christina Garcia Frasco set to exit and Patrick "Pato" Gregorio preparing to step in as Tourism Secretary.

The shift is expected to happen sooner rather than later, with conversations suggesting that only final paperwork and formal announcements remain. Within tourism circles, the transition is already being treated as a done deal.

Here’s why radar sees Gregorio as a strong fit for the role. He is formally trained in tourism and built his career in hospitality management, including senior leadership roles at major properties such as The Manila Hotel and Waterfront Hotels and Resorts, where success is measured in arrivals, occupancy, and guest experience. His background places him squarely on the execution side of tourism, not just promotion.

That focus carried into his work as chair of the National Sports Tourism–Inter Agency Committee. Under that framework, four world championships in gymnastics, futsal, surfing, and volleyball last year brought thousands of tourists to the Philippines, translating events into real visitor traffic.

With pressure mounting for results, this handover signals a clear pivot toward delivery and outcomes.

Report by Kenneth M. del Rosario
